title: [TEST] Factory implement dry-run: add /api/health liveness route
body:
## Plan link
(factory implement dry-run — a genuine small, self-contained change to validate the implement workflow end-to-end; safe to close after.)

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] Add a Next.js App Router route handler at `app/api/health/route.ts` that responds to `GET` with HTTP 200 and JSON body `{ "status": "ok" }`
- [ ] Add a Vitest unit test asserting the 200 status and the `{ status: "ok" }` body

## In-scope surface
`app/api/health/route.ts` and one unit test under `tests/` (or colocated per repo convention).

## Out of scope
Auth, database/Snowflake checks, any change to existing routes or config.

## Verification notes
`npx vitest run` passes the new test; `npx tsc --noEmit` and `npx eslint .` clean.

## Size declaration
Thin (~30 lines).
